//: Copy to dart_defines.json and pass with --dart-define-from-file=dart_defines.json.
//api: Backend base URL. Overrides the per-platform default in lib/core/network/api_config.dart.
//google-signin: Optional — overrides the Web client ID baked into lib/core/network/google_auth_config.dart.
//maps: Module 6 — the map. "maplibre" (default): OpenStreetMap vector maps, no key needed.
//maps1: "google": Google Maps, which needs the keys below (Google Cloud console → Credentials).
//maps2: Google only. Web: Maps JavaScript API, restricted to your site's HTTP referrers. Android: Maps SDK
//maps3: for Android, restricted to com.khojlo.khojlo + your SHA-1 (the Android build reads it from here).
//maps4: Leave empty with MAP_PROVIDER=google to get the built-in preview map.
//firebase: Push notifications on the WEB (Module 9). Android uses android/app/google-services.json
//firebase2: instead. Values: Firebase console → Project settings → Your apps → the web app →
//firebase3: SDK setup and configuration → Config. Leave the placeholders to keep web push off.
//vapid: Cloud Messaging → Web configuration → Web Push certificates → Generate key pair (public key).
